notes: Piece counts match the 140-piece parts list (60 lines); build order is the booklet's 41 steps, with sub-assemblies (steps 26, 29, 34, 36, 40, 41) expanded.

Fix for the tile errors: tiles (yellow 2x4 and 1x2 tiles, the grey 1x8 tiles) have no studs, so nothing rests on them. Pieces that sit in the same layer (black 2x4 plates, the black half-round plates b40/b41, the chin plates and hearts) are now attached only to studded parts: the yellow wedge plates (b4, b5), the blue plates (b11, b12), the red 2x10 plate (b15) and the yellow 2x6 plate (b33). The tiles stay in the model as the flush canvas surface and only rest on the white base plates.
Positions are null as instructed. rests_on is inferred from the isometric drawings, so some contacts in the layered face and the back frame are best-effort.

The first white 4x12 plate is b1. The other three (b13, b14, b22) are slid in underneath later, so they have no pieces below them. Pieces above them list them in rests_on even though their ids are later.
After step 21 the model is flipped: the 1x16 and 1x10 bricks and 1x10 plates are clutched to the underside of the white 4x12 plates, so their rests_on lists those plates.
The stand (step 26) is an elbow-axle-hinge cylinder assembly joined to the two white hinge plates (b76, b77) by hinges.
Steps 13 and 14 use the 2x4 wedge plates (lego-51739). Step 16 uses the left and right 2x2 wedge plates. The yellow wedge plates (step 2) are both listed as lego-24307 in the parts list.
The step 41 nose is a dome on a hinge top plate that hinges onto the hinge base placed in step 35.
